# License

AutoEDA is released under the **MIT License**.

## Why MIT?

We chose the MIT License because:

-   It is permissive and allows reuse in academic, open-source, and commercial projects
-   It aligns well with the Python open-source ecosystem
-   It minimizes legal friction for contributors and users
-   It supports the collaborative goals of DSCI 524

## Full License Text
